description: This file defines an abstract class for user-defined aggregate functions (UDAFs) in Apache Spark, including schema definitions, initialization, update, merge, and evaluation methods, as well as a class for mutable aggregation buffers.

classes.name: UserDefinedAggregateFunction
classes.description: Abstract class for defining user-defined aggregate functions (UDAFs) in Spark, including schema, initialization, update, merge, and evaluation methods, with deprecation notice.

classes.name: MutableAggregationBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class representing a mutable aggregation buffer used in UDAFs, extending Row and allowing updates to its values.

methods.name: inputSchema
methods.description: Returns the schema of input arguments for the UDAF.

methods.name: bufferSchema
methods.description: Returns the schema of the aggregation buffer.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the UDAF's output.

methods.name: deterministic
methods.description: Indicates whether the function is deterministic.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the buffer with new input data.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Computes the final result from the buffer.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a Column for the UDAF with given input Columns.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Creates a Column for the UDAF with distinct input Columns.
